articles.title: Iran’s ‘missing’ pilots found alive: Did US allies in Gulf just get a shocking warning from Tehran?
articles.description: Iran has made a startling new claim about three military pilots missing since their Su-24 jets went down during attacks on Qatar amid the U.S.-Israel war. Tehran says Javad Salehi, Abdolmajid Dashtian and Omran Behraveshian survived and were captured alive by Qatari forces, while a fourth pilot was returned to Iran dead. Iranian officials allege the three have spent months in custody without contact with their families or access for Tehran's representatives. After months of uncertainty over their fate, why is Iran revealing the alleged capture only now?

articles.title: Iran reveals what it pulled from the sky: April 2026 F-15 wreckage on cam, 10 UAVs hit? US shocked
articles.description: Iran has opened an underground IRGC “war trophy” vault filled with wreckage it claims came from U.S. and Israeli aircraft during the 40-day war. Tehran says its integrated air defenses struck 171 aerial vehicles, including 10 manned aircraft. The display features alleged parts from American MQ-9 drones, Israeli Hermes-series UAVs and Starlink-linked communications equipment. Iran also showcased what it claims are remains of a U.S. F-15 destroyed during the April fighting. Tehran is presenting the vault as proof of its wartime success, but do the exhibits substantiate its claims?

articles.title: Former Air Chief Marshal BS Dhanoa EXCLUSIVE On Kargil War, GPS Issues, Precision Strikes & More
articles.description: In a mega exclusive with Times Now, former Chief of Air Staff Air Chief Marshal BS Dhanoa looks back at Operation Safed Sagar and the Kargil War, revealing some of India's biggest lessons from the conflict. Dhanoa says technology had to be on India's side, highlighting the role of precision weapons, self-protection systems, UAVs, satellites and advanced reconnaissance capabilities in overcoming key deficiencies. He also discusses the GPS challenges faced during Kargil, explaining that the issues stemmed from map-datum differences and built-in system errors rather than deliberate US interference. #bsdhanoa #airchiefmarshalbsdhanoa #operationsafedsagar #kargilwar #kargil #kargilwar1999 #indianairforce #iaf #timesnow

articles.title: ‘Armed Naxals gone, but ideological Naxals seek opportunities’: PM Modi urges ‘Identify & Isolate’
articles.description: From the Red Fort on India’s 80th Independence Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi warned against what he called ‘intellectual Naxals’ (Dimagi Naxals), saying the armed insurgency may be declining but its ideological challenge remains. He alleged that people with a Maoist mindset had influenced government committees and public policy, urging citizens to ‘identify and isolate’ them. Modi also recalled the human cost of decades of Naxal violence, hailed progress in ending insurgency and called on young Indians to contribute to a ‘Nasha Mukt Bharat’.
